text: ふー　こくさい　じあいに　きんちょー　したぜ

structure.jp: こくさい　じあいに
きんちょー　したぜ

patterns.name: 〜に (cause)
patterns.span: こくさい　じあいに　きんちょー　した
patterns.explanation: に here points to the thing that set off the feeling. こくさい じあいに きんちょー した = 'I got nervous over the international match'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes the statement at the listener. きんちょー したぜ = 'I got nervous, man'.
